newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mostly weak but fuel barges firm.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mostly weak but fuel barges firm.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly weaker on Thursday, traders said.
Spot naphtha markets were slightly weaker again with volatile crude keeping buyers scarce.
Gasoline was easier. Traders said prices had dipped with futures, but tight Rotterdam supplies had cushioned falls.
Gas oil was mainly lower, apart from in the barge market where prompt premiums surged on tight supply.
High sulphur cracked fuel oil barges were firmer. Trade was heard at $108 and $109 fob ARA, $3 above Wednesday's levels
